title: Urgency: Crash AAPS after update samsung One UI 4.1
symptom: After updating Samsung One UI 4.1 (Android 12), AAPS crashes and cannot be used. The user reports the crash occurs on versions 3.0.0.1 and 3.0.0.2.
fix: The user resolved the crash by clearing the app cache and force stopping the app, then quickly pressing the next button to unlock the situation. Another user suggested deleting all files and folders, backing up parameters, deleting the database, uninstalling AAPS, rebooting the phone, reinstalling AAPS, and setting parameters without using a backup.
evidence_quote: after removing the cache and stopping force of the app I had the time a few seconds press the next button which allowed to unlock the situation and not crash the application anymore
